edits.old: Then the admin traffic moves only after the check passes, the old colour keeps serving until it does, and a failed check leaves the old colour in place and marks the release failed
edits.new:
Then the admin traffic moves only after the check passes, the old colour keeps serving until it does, and a failed check leaves the old colour in place and marks the release failed

  Scenario: AC10 The release writes one schema, uses one login and reads its neighbours only through contracts (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb_agent login reference, its grants and the contracts of the neighbour services
    When the api and the worker read a neighbour, read a case fact, read an extracted document field and write during the migration
    Then the release uses the rwb_agent login reference and no other service's credential, and it holds no grant on the recovery schema or on another service schema
    Then it writes only schema rwb_agent, reads a neighbour only through its contract, a case fact only through the rwb-source-data tool contract and an extracted document field only through the rwb-document tool contract, one hop with the 2 second budget
    Then a read outside a contract, a grant on the recovery schema or on another service schema and a cross-schema key are refused by the boundary check of the release
